summary: I have always been searching for my Mendely, Zotero replacement. I am so bad at organization. I like hypothes.is for social annotation but wanted to own my Commonplace Book. So I finally brought 1,778 PDFs to my own website #digped
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I have always been searching for my Mendely, Zotero replacement. I am so bad at organization. I like hypothes.is for social annotation but wanted to own my Commonplace Book. So I finally brought 1,778 PDFs to my own website #digped
